تستقطروا (form X)
# تَسْتَقْطِرُوا (tastaqṭirū) /tas.taq.tˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْطَرَ (istaqṭara)
# تُسْتَقْطَرُوا (tustaqṭarū) /tus.taq.tˤa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْطَرَ (istaqṭara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
